title: Digital Surrogate
description: A digital file produced by digitising a physical source carrier, modelled as a CRMdig D1 Digital Object. Adds a mandatory PROV derivation link to the source-carrier and a structured CRMdig D7 digitisation event sub-object.

type.description: Fixed type token (maps to crmdig:D1_Digital_Object via JSON-LD context).

wasDerivedFrom.description: Persistent URI of the source-carrier (physical original) from which this digital file was produced (prov:wasDerivedFrom). Must reference an ogc.heritage.source-carrier record.

digitisationEvent.description: Structured record of the CRMdig D7 Digital Machine Event that created this digital surrogate. The digitisation method and date are mandatory; all other fields are optional paradata.

method.description: Digitisation technique used, e.g. "flatbed scan", "digital photography", "photogrammetry", "RTI", "multispectral imaging".

date.description: Date on which the digitisation was performed (ISO 8601, e.g. "2024-03-15").

equipment.description: Make and model of the scanner, camera or acquisition instrument.

software.description: Software used for capture or initial format conversion.

operator.description: Person or organisation responsible for the digitisation.

resolution.description: Scan resolution or pixel density, e.g. "600dpi", "24MP", "3 cm/pixel GSD".

colourMode.description: Colour mode of the output file, e.g. "RGB", "grayscale", "bitonal".

quality.description: Quality or tier label of this file within the derivative chain, e.g. "master", "access copy", "thumbnail".

processingHistory.description: Free-text description of post-processing steps applied after capture.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the digital surrogate file (dct:format), e.g. "image/tiff", "image/jpeg", "application/pdf". Required.

rights.description: Access rights or licence for this digital surrogate (dct:rights), e.g. a Creative Commons URI or a label such as "Restricted — archive access only". Required.

iiifManifest.description: URI of an IIIF Presentation API manifest for this digital surrogate, enabling deep-zoom or annotation in IIIF viewers (crm:P70i_is_documented_in).

completeness.description: Free-text statement on coverage completeness, e.g. "complete", "pages 3–5 missing due to damage", "recto only".
